name: Enrich & Qualify new lead from Alta
description: Dave.io Alta reply intake (hardcoded Dave row). POST /webhook/alta-dave-new-reply. GPT screen gate: PASS/AUTO and CRM duplicates end silently. DiscoLike+Supersoniq enrich, qualify+notify, Slack card + thread ts, run log, fires addon-newlead-alta-{slug}.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Capture-Payload.js
@@file:nodes/Client-Vars.js
@@file:nodes/Alta-Normalize.js

options.systemMessage:
You classify a prospect's reply to cold outreach. Output JSON only, one field: verdict.

verdict = INTERESTED when the reply shows any openness: questions, curiosity, timing interest (even 'maybe later this quarter'), asks for more info, booking talk, or forwarding to a SPECIFIC named person with a door open.
verdict = PASS when they clearly decline: not interested, we are good, stop reaching out, unsubscribe, remove me, a firm no with no door open - AND ALSO when the person says they left the company or are no longer the right person, unless they hand over a specific named colleague to continue with. A polite sign-off like 'best of luck' or 'let me know if you have questions' does NOT make a pass interested.
verdict = AUTO for out-of-office and automated replies.

When otherwise uncertain, choose INTERESTED - a human reviews everything downstream, and losing a real lead costs more than reviewing a pass.

parameters.filterByFormula: =AND(FIND("{{ $('Client Vars').first().json.clientName }}", ARRAYJOIN({Client})), OR(AND("{{ $('Alta Normalize').item.json.enrich_domain }}" != "", {domain} = "{{ $('Alta Normalize').item.json.enrich_domain }}"), LOWER({Name}) = LOWER("{{ $('Alta Normalize').item.json.company_name }}")))

value.Name: ={{ $('Alta Normalize').item.json.company_name || $('Alta Normalize').item.json.full_name || $('Alta Normalize').item.json.lead_email }}
value.Dedup Key: ={{ String($('Client Vars').first().json.clientSlug || '').toLowerCase().trim() }}|{{ ($('Alta Normalize').first().json.is_freemail ? String($('Alta Normalize').first().json.lead_email || '') : String($('Alta Normalize').first().json.domain || $('Alta Normalize').first().json.enrich_domain || String($('Alta Normalize').first().json.lead_email || '').split('@')[1] || '')).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^www\./, '') }}
